# Transform from couch potato to confident runner in just 9 weeks

Couch to 5K guides you through the proven beginner training program that's helped millions discover the joy of running. This revolutionary approach takes complete beginners from zero running experience to confidently completing a 5K race in just nine weeks.

## The Couch to 5K method

The Couch to 5K program was originally developed by Josh Clark in 1996 as a simple, gradual approach to building running endurance. The method has become the gold standard for beginner runners worldwide, transforming sedentary individuals into confident athletes through carefully structured progression.

No experience required. Our structured 9-week program gradually builds your cardiovascular endurance with the perfect mix of walking and running intervals. Whether you've never run before or haven't exercised in years, Couch to 5K meets you exactly where you are.

**Perfect for absolute beginners:**
- Gentle progression from walking to running over 9 structured weeks
- Voice guidance keeps you motivated throughout every workout
- Complete workouts in just 20-30 minutes, three times per week
- Train at your own pace with built-in rest days for recovery
- No gym membership or expensive equipment required

## Smart training features that keep you motivated

**Audio coaching:** Crystal-clear voice cues tell you exactly when to run, walk, and rest throughout your workout. No need to constantly watch your screen - just focus on running while the app guides you through each interval.

**Comprehensive progress tracking:** Watch your running journey unfold as you complete workouts and steadily build toward your 5K goal. Visual progress indicators show how far you've come and what milestones await.

**Flexible scheduling:** Work out anytime, anywhere that suits your lifestyle. Pause and resume sessions as needed for water breaks or unexpected interruptions.

**Detailed week-by-week history:** Track all your achievements and celebrate every milestone. Review past workouts to see your improvement patterns and gain confidence from your progress.

## Built for real life challenges

Life happens, and Couch to 5K understands that. The program adapts to your real-world schedule with intelligent session pausing and pickup-where-you-left-off functionality. Missed a day? No problem.

The app includes flexible repeat options - if a particular week feels challenging, repeat workouts until you feel ready to progress. Feeling strong? Move ahead at your own pace.

## Privacy-first fitness philosophy

Your fitness journey is deeply personal, and Couch to 5K respects that privacy. All your workout data stays securely on your devices. No mandatory accounts, no social pressure, no forced sharing required.

**iOS integration excellence:**
- Clean, intuitive interface that feels naturally integrated with iOS
- Haptic feedback provides subtle workout cues for distraction-free running
- Background notifications keep you motivated and on track
- Full compatibility with iOS 17 and later versions
- Apple Watch integration for convenient wrist-based tracking

## Join the global running revolution

Over 2 million people worldwide have successfully completed their first 5K using the Couch to 5K method. This proven system has transformed lives, built confidence, and created lifelong runners across every continent.

You're just 9 weeks away from crossing that finish line with confidence and strength. Your transformation starts with a single step, and Couch to 5K provides the roadmap for every step that follows.

Download Couch to 5K today and begin your journey from the couch to the finish line. Your future runner self is waiting.

The original progressive eight-week plan gently alternates running and walking, building your stamina a little more each session so you never feel overwhelmed. It is the perfect beginner running plan for anyone learning to run from scratch.

WHY RUNNERS LOVE RUN5K
- A structured couch to 5K program that tells you exactly what to do, session by session.
- Run-walk intervals with clear audio, voice and haptic cues so you can keep your phone in your pocket.
- A big, glanceable workout timer that counts down every warm-up, run and walk segment.
- Pause, resume and skip freely - the plan adapts to your day.
- A follow-on 5K to 10K plan for when you are ready to go further.

YOUR INTERVAL RUN-WALK COACH
The heart of Run5K is its interval coach. Every workout is broken into easy-to-follow segments: a gentle warm-up walk, timed running intervals, recovery walks and a cool down. Spoken announcements and vibration cues tell you exactly when to run and when to walk, so you can focus on your breathing and your surroundings instead of watching the screen. It works entirely offline, so it is perfect for the park, the treadmill, the track or the trail.

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
- Track every completed session and watch your weekly running time and distance grow.
- A calendar streak heatmap keeps you motivated to lace up again and again.
- Clear charts show how far you have come, from your first walk to your first 5K.
- Personal records celebrate your longest run, your best week and your longest streak.

ACHIEVEMENTS AND MOTIVATION
Unlock dozens of badges as you reach milestones - your first run, your first full week, your first non-stop kilometre and many more. Gentle, optional reminders help you stay consistent, because consistency is exactly what turns a beginner into a runner.

PERFECT FOR
- Absolute beginners learning to run for the very first time.
- Former runners getting back into shape after a long break.
- Walkers who want to progress to jogging and running.
- Anyone training for a first 5K fun run or a charity race.
- Busy people who want a simple running plan for beginners without a subscription or a personal coach.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Run5K respects your privacy. Everything runs on your device with no account, no sign-up and no internet connection required to train. Your workout history stays on your phone. There is no route tracking on a map and no personal data is collected by us. You are always in control of your information.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE
Run5K is a general fitness and training app and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Please consult your doctor before beginning any new exercise program, especially if you have any health concerns.

Start today. Download Run5K, press start, and take the first step from the couch to your first 5K - one run-walk interval at a time. Every runner started somewhere, and Run5K is here to help you make it a habit that lasts.

Today's workout, your readiness, weekly progress, race predictions, PRs -- one glance away.

Choose your intervals.

Change the order.

Save your workouts.

Do not want to set anything up? You do not have to.

Forget the stopwatch.

Get a heads-up before each switch.

Listen for cues.

AFTER YOUR WORKOUT

See the big picture.
Time, distance, and pace are saved in your report.

Break it down by interval.

Track changes over time.

IF YOU RUN WITH APPLE WATCH

Leave your phone at home.
Start directly from Apple Watch and let Ekiro guide you through every stage without your iPhone.

Set your own heart-rate limits.

EKIRO COACH

You run. Ekiro Coach helps you decide what to do next.

After your run, tell Ekiro Coach how it felt by rating the effort from 1 to 10.

Based on your rating, Ekiro Coach suggests your next workout. Its recommendations follow the principle of gradually increasing training load used by professional coaches.

Felt easy?

Felt right?
Coach may suggest keeping the same load and staying at that level a little longer.

Felt hard?
Coach may suggest making the next workout easier, without sudden jumps in load.

You decide.
Ekiro Coach suggests the next step, but accepting it or keeping your workout unchanged is always your choice.

It compares your training plan against the runs in Apple Health and shows you, honestly, how the two lined up across your whole block. No plan yet? It can build you one to start from.
